#
# AAC-LC, written here. No submodule, no runtime library, no OS codec -- the
# second decoder in this tree with no dependency of any kind, after decode_alac.
#
# aac_tables.cpp is generated by tools/gen_aac_tables.py and committed, so no
# build needs the network or Python.
#
# The module itself does not exist yet: this builds the codec as a library so
# that the tests and the fuzzer can drive it while the filterbank is written.

add_library(mediaperch_aac STATIC aac.cpp aac_tables.cpp)
target_include_directories(mediaperch_aac PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(mediaperch_aac PUBLIC mediaperch_mp4 PRIVATE mediaperch_flags)
set_target_properties(mediaperch_aac PROPERTIES FOLDER "modules")
